dct_title_s: Satellite Detected Waters over Zaporizhzhia Power Plant, Zaporizka Oblast in Ukraine as of 09 June 2023
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code FL20230606UKR** This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters using Sentinel-1 images acquired on the 09th of June 2023 at 15:36 UTC. Within the analysed area of 260 km², along the Dnieper River, surface waters appear to have receded by about 12km². The water level of the cooling pond seems to be stable as of 09 June 2023. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
